title: Destiny Path
author: Kristin Hannah
description:
Jude Faraday is a happy wife and mother, completely devoted to her children. Her twins Mia and Zach are smart and happy teenagers. When their classmate Lexie Bale, who grew up in foster homes, enters the Faraday family's lives, Jude is the one who provides her with the greatest support. Lexie quickly becomes Mia's best friend, and Zach falls in love with her, and the three of them become inseparable. But her senior year of high school brings unexpected misfortune when one night Jude's worst nightmares come true: there is a car accident. In an instant, her idyllic life is shaken to its core. Jude wants someone to be punished for what happened, and it seems that eighteen-year-old Lexie Bale is to blame.

Lexi loses everything that matters to her—the boy she loves, her place in the family, her best friend.

Years later, she returns, her heart still filled with feelings for Zach. Having endured her punishment and wiser than ever, she demands justice. And then Jude will have to face the woman Lexie has become.
